product.description: With one of the lowest annual fees in the market, and a range of insurances, the Qantas Business Credit Card will help your points soar. You will also receive up to 55 days interest free on purchases.

A business must be a Qantas Business Rewards member to earn Qantas Points for business. A one-off join fee of $89.50 including GST normally applies, however this will be waived for Bendigo Bank customers upon approval of a new Qantas Business Credit Card facility. Membership and Qantas Points are subject to the Bendigo Business Credit Card Terms.
features.additionalValue: Earn 0.6 Qantas points for every $1 spent on everyday business spend;Earn 0.3 Qantas Points for every $1 spent on eligible utilities and government transactions;Earn 1.6 Qantas Points for every $1 spent on selected Qantas products and services. (T&Cs Apply)
